values.meaning: Duration of the bonus attack speed
values.quote: '''Miss Fortune''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds.

values.meaning: Cooldown reduction on Strut when Love Tap marks a new target
values.quote: reduces ''Strut's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by {{tt|2 seconds|Affected by ability haste}}
values.binNote: Bin computes LoveTapRefund = LoveTapBaseRefund(2) * an unresolved CooldownMultiplierCalculationPart, presumably an ability-haste-derived multiplier; the wiki quotes the flat 2 seconds and notes it is affected by ability haste separately, consistent with the base value.

mechanics.claim: The passive movement speed bonus is lost only from taking actual (non-zero) damage, not from 0-damage instances.
mechanics.quote: The bonus movement speed is not lost from taking [[Damage#0_Damage_Instances|0 damage instances]].

mechanics.claim: Casting the active grants the maximum passive movement speed bonus instantly.
The passive movement speed bonus only builds up while out of combat (not taking non-periodic damage) for 4 then a further 3 seconds.
mechanics.quote: '''Miss Fortune''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after 4 seconds without taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|periodic}} damage. This bonus is increased after another 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: Marking a new target with Love Tap (Q) reduces the current remaining cooldown of Strut (W), letting the attack speed active be recast sooner.
mechanics.quote: Marking a new target with ''{{ai|Love Tap|Miss Fortune}}'' reduces ''Strut's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by {{tt|2 seconds|Affected by ability haste}}.
